title: Turret homing via color sensor index (cable at camera-forward)
description: Homing: swing toward center watching PORT_1 color; stop on sustained deviation; record encoder = forward reference; track absolute turret angle via encoder + 125 ticks/deg (measured). OPEN: first detected feature (enc -3468) does not match expected cable position - identify landmarks by re-crossing at the same encoder value. Turret travel is cable-limited - never rotate unbounded. Evidence: doc/sources/2026-10-25-turret-calibration.md

title: Decide v2 perception accelerator (NCS1 vs CPU-first vs other USB)
description: Robot has an Intel NCS1 in boot mode with a dead archived SDK; Coral EOL 2026; Hailo needs PCIe (RPi 3 lacks it). Recommendation: CPU INT8 inference as default backend, NCS1 as experimental option (mirror'd NCSDK per ncs-legacy-support.md), keep inference behind a backend interface. Decide before vision Phase 5. Evidence: doc/sources/2026-10-24-ncs-state.md

title: camerad: Rust Kinect capture daemon (libfreenect FFI, throttled)
description: Replace unthrottled KinectProcess: libfreenect C API via FFI (callback + process_events_timeout, latest-frame-wins), throttled to 10-15 fps, frames only for client stream / features for control. Start from external/libfreenect-rs + regen libfreenect-sys. Fixes koc-hw-kinect-wedge. API surface: doc/architecture/kinect-interface.md

title: motord: Rust BrickPi+ UART driver prototype (protocol parity vs BrickPi.py)
description: Implement the BrickPi+ protocol in Rust over serialport-rs: 500kbaud /dev/ttyS0, framing [dest][checksum][count][payload] (tx) / [checksum][count][payload] (rx), two ATmega destinations (1,2), MSG_TYPE VALUES/E_STOP/TIMEOUT_SETTINGS. Enable the firmware deadman (TIMEOUT_SETTINGS), wire E_STOP to crash handlers, port the US-sensor I2C workaround. Validate with differential tests vs BrickPi.py on the robot. Protocol: doc/architecture/brickpi-interface.md

title: Write v2 implementation plan in doc/plans (resolve open questions first)
description: Resolve vision open questions (BrickPi driver strategy, capture sidecar, client transport, OS path), then write the phased implementation plan. User approval required before coding.

title: KOC v2: microduck-aligned software stack
description: Rebuild KOC software as microduck-style stack: Rust daemons (motord/camerad/configd/updaterd/robotctl) over JSON-RPC/UDS, intents-not-motor-writes, throttled capture, health-gated updates. Keep v1 running until each phase passes probe parity. Direction: doc/vision/v2-microduck-stack.md

title: sync.sh deploys to wrong directory and pushes local-only dirs
description: sync.sh targets pi@$ROBOT_IP:~/$(basename of local dir) = ~/koc, but the robot deployment is ~/rpi_lego_robot - next sync would create a duplicate tree. Also missing excludes for .beads/ (embedded Dolt DB), .claude/, external/ (146 MB of reference clones). Fix: explicit target dir name + extend exclude list. Evidence: doc/development/robot-deployment.md

title: Kinect capture wedge: unthrottled loop + fork-inherited ZMQ fds stall server telemetry
description: KinectProcess (multiprocessing fork) is started after the parent server has created its ZMQ context/sockets, so the child inherits copies of them (visible in ss output: child owns fds on :5557). The capture loop is also unthrottled: 5.7 GB pushed to the aggregator in 33 min at 139% CPU. After some minutes the aggregator stops publishing (360 KB stranded unread in its TCP recv buffer) and BrickPiWrapper stops sending, with no Python errors logged. Restarting server.py recovers. Kinect also sits behind two USB hubs causing libfreenect resync storms (log spam, likely contributes). Fix: throttle capture loop (sleep to ~10-15 fps), fork Kinect before creating parent ZMQ sockets or use spawn, move Kinect to a dedicated USB port. Evidence: doc/sources/2026-10-24-robot-state-capture.md
